Notifications

Configure alerts and webhook notifications to stay informed about project changes.

Notifications

API router for notification webhook management and dispatch.

This module provides the REST API endpoints for managing Microsoft Teams webhook configurations and triggering notification dispatches.

Endpoints

The router exposes the following endpoints under /api/v1/notifications/webhooks:

  • GET / — List all active webhooks.

  • POST / — Create a new webhook configuration.

  • GET /{webhook_id} — Get a specific webhook’s details.

  • PUT /{webhook_id} — Update an existing webhook configuration.

  • DELETE /{webhook_id} — Delete a webhook configuration.

  • POST /{webhook_id}/test — Send a test notification to verify a webhook.

  • POST /dispatch — Manually trigger a notification event dispatch.

Webhook Management

Webhooks are associated with specific portfolio nodes. When an event occurs on a node, notifications are dispatched to all active webhooks associated with that node or any of its ancestors in the tree hierarchy.

Each webhook records its max_permitted_classification, which determines the highest security classification level it may receive. If a node’s classification exceeds this limit, the notification is automatically redacted.

Security

All endpoints require authentication via JWT token. Only users with appropriate clearance levels can create or modify webhooks for classified portfolio nodes.

Usage

# Create a new webhook
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/notifications/webhooks \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{
"portfolio_node_id": "uuid",
"channel_name": "Project Alpha Ops",
"webhook_url": "https://outlook.office.com/webhook/...",
"max_permitted_classification": "OFFICIAL"
}'

# Send a test notification
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/notifications/webhooks/{id}/test \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
